sql: SELECT player_id FROM player_award WHERE year = 2010 AND award_id = 'Rookie of the Year'
SELECT MIN(votes), yearid FROM hall_of_fame WHERE inducted = 'Y' AND yearid >= 1871 GROUP BY yearid
SELECT T1.birth_country FROM player AS T1 JOIN hall_of_fame AS T2 ON T1.player_id = T2.player_id WHERE T2.inducted = 'Y' AND T2.yearid >= 1871
SELECT T1.award_id FROM player_award AS T1 JOIN salary AS T2 ON T1.player_id = T2.player_id ORDER BY T2.salary DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT T2.award_id, T1.name_first, T1.name_last, MAX(T1.birth_year) FROM player AS T1 JOIN player_award AS T2 ON T1.player_id = T2.player_id GROUP BY T2.award_id
